purpose: Curated local/presential radar input for JOBAS. Records are factual source-backed opportunities; personal fit is computed only in the browser from the user's local profile.

findingSchema.title: string
findingSchema.category: customer-success | support | travel | admin-va | operations | sales | marketing | ecommerce-crm | content-social | data-ai | tech | finance | other

salary.raw: published salary text or No publicado

rules: Verify active status before adding or refreshing a record.
Do not include pay-to-apply opportunities or records with strong scam indicators.
Use direct source/application URLs where available.
Do not invent compensation; preserve the published text and null numeric values when unknown.
Do not store candidate-specific fit scores, owner preferences, outreach state, or private candidate data in this file.
Server-side ordering uses only generic public signals; personal relevance belongs to the browser-local profile.
